diagnosis.narrative: The series is dominated by a strong downward trend (a net fall of ~48% of its level). There is little seasonal structure. The series is quite predictable: its energy concentrates in a few structured frequencies. The series reads as non-stationary by the ADF/KPSS tests. A few outliers stand out (1 points, ~0% of the sample). Across validation windows the model ranking is moderate (Kendall tau 0.329), which favours a weighted combination.
